claim: Google's February 2026 Minnesota package pairs a new data centre with 1.9 GW of clean energy, including a 300 MW / 30 GWh iron-air battery designed for roughly 100 hours of storage.
comparisonContext: This is a concrete example of a hyperscale project being designed around renewables plus long-duration storage rather than only around firm thermal generation.
scopeNote: Industry announcement and reporting; regulatory approval and project execution still matter.
sourceTitle: A new Google data center triggers 1.9 GW of clean energy in Minnesota
